title: Subdomain Schema
description: JSON schema for Context Mapper DSL Subdomain definitions

name.description: Name of the Subdomain. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores.

type.description: Type of subdomain according to DDD strategic design

domainVisionStatement.description: A brief statement describing the subdomain's purpose and scope

entities.description: List of main entities in this subdomain

services.description: List of domain services in this subdomain
